title: Kirby Problem 2.13
exact_target: Characterize exactly when two embedded graphs on a surface are connected by the source’s disk-face surgery moves, without restricting to unicellular or fixed-valence cases.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2761 (KP-2.13). CC BY 4.0.

R. İnanç Baykur, Robion C. Kirby and Daniel Ruberman, eds., \emph{K3: A New Problem List in Low-Dimensional Topology}, Mathematical Surveys and Monographs 295, American Mathematical Society (2026), Problem 2.13 and its remarks; Chapters 1 and 2 for the stated conventions.
